description: Golden corpus for credential-receipt.v1; the secrets here are synthetic (EXAMPLE filler) and the scanner is extended to prove it (G-73).

accept.why: An issue receipt: the credential's metadata and the one-time secret.
A rotate receipt names its parent and narrows.

reject.why: A receipt without its secret is the one thing it exists to deliver.
Revoke returns an entry, not a receipt.
A receipt describes a credential just issued: active.
A new credential carries its fingerprint.
No revocation members at issue time.
A secret is prefix_ plus 32..128 URL-safe characters.
The secret belongs beside the credential, never inside its metadata.

reject_by_client.why: display_prefix is the first characters of the secret: a receipt whose secret does not begin with it is internally inconsistent.
A rotate receipt whose parent is the new credential itself: lineage that cannot exist.
